content.summary: The quote for the Meyer order is checked against the pricing brief: the discounted total is wrong and the delivery date lacks a source. Revise the total before it is sent.

findings.title: Discounted total does not follow from the unit prices
findings.summary: Paragraph 2, sentence 1: total 1,190 EUR (expected: 1,071 EUR after the 10 percent discount).
findings.explanation: A customer would be charged 119 EUR too much. Fix: state 1,071 EUR.
findings.why: The customer would be charged 119 EUR too much.

findings.title: Delivery date has no source
findings.summary: Paragraph 4: delivery in 5 days (expected: a cited lead time).
findings.explanation: The promise cannot be verified. Fix: cite the lead time or drop the date.
findings.expected: A lead time taken from the pricing brief
findings.why: A date without a source can be missed unnoticed.
findings.fix_instruction: Cite the lead time from the brief or remove the date.

evidence_summaries.summary: Recomputing 1,190 EUR minus 10 percent gives 1,071 EUR.

limitations.summary: The shipping costs were not part of the brief and are not checked.

decision.next_action: Correct the total and cite the lead time.

content.next_action_text: Correct the total and cite the lead time.
content.case_header: Quote for the Meyer order checked against the pricing brief: totals, discount and delivery promise.
content.decisive_reason: The discounted total contradicts the unit prices and would overcharge the customer.
next_steps: Cite the lead time or remove the delivery date.
